  PROBLEM: In `_heal_counterfactual_hold_expiry_check`, the expired_marker_post_failed branch now sends its lost-response Telegram alert at DEBUG instead of WARNING, so the default `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=WARNING` filter drops it, even though the alert's own text asks a person to "close or answer it by hand".
  WHY: If GitHub creates the hold-expired comment but the single-attempt POST reports failure, the issue is reopened, and every later tick keeps it as `kept reason=reopened` (lines 21229-21230) with no expiry retry and no Telegram message, so the hold can stay open indefinitely. The only signal left is the ::warning:: line at 21297. Reviewers disagree on severity: openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash downgraded it to NIT because the trigger is narrow, it is not a regression from pre-PR behaviour, and DEBUG stops a repeat of about 96 alerts per day per issue in the common case. The highest rating is used here.

If the hold-expired comment appears anyway, the hold will not expire on its own; close or answer it by hand." "DEBUG" || true | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Telegram alert moved from WARNING to DEBUG, so the default threshold drops it. The filter chain is tg_notify_issue (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:948-966), then tg_send_msg/_tg_should_send (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:90-96 and 133-136), with ALERT_MSG_LEVEL defaulting to 'WARNING' in orchestrate_poll.yml (line 1091). The change also contradicts scripts/tg_helpers.sh:48-52, which says WARNING means "a human has to act".
  WHY: In the lost-response case the next tick returns kept reason=reopened with no Telegram message and no warning, so the hold never expires and no one is notified. This matches pre-PR behaviour, so it is not a regression, and DEBUG is justified for the common repeat-every-tick case. The trigger is narrow, so the reviewer rated it a NIT rather than MAJOR. The reviewer's hardening suggestion (risk score 1): keep DEBUG, and either add an "ai:heal-counterfactual-hold-expired:v1 … close or answer it by hand" note to the README row for HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_HOLD_EXPIRY_ENABLED or emit a ::notice:: in the kept/reopened branch.
